transcript: Speaker A: AI teacher jo sirf 15 dinaan vich English sikhaundi hai, hun bahut viral ho rahi hai. Aao, Arya da dilon swagat kariye! Arya, tusi keh rahe ho ki English sikhan layi grammar diyaan kitaaban ya coaching classes di zaroorat nahi hai? [The AI teacher who teaches English in just 15 days is now going very viral. Let's heartily welcome Arya! Arya, are you saying that there is no need for grammar books or coaching classes to learn English?] Speaker B: Bilkul sahi. Purana tareeka eh si ki lokaan nu English bolan layi kehya janda si, bina eh samjhaaye ki English asal vich hundi ki hai. Par jiven tusi apni maa boli sikhde ho, ohi tarah English vi gall-baat te practice naal kudrati taur te aa jandi hai. English sikhan layi jo vi tuhanu chahida hai, oh sab MySivi app vich maujood hai, te main tuhanu step-by-step guide kardi haan. Jadon tusi is tareeke naal practice karde ho, tuhanu har roz progress nazar aundi hai. Is karke sirf 15 dinaan vich fluent English bolna mumkin ho janda hai. [Absolutely right. The old way was that people were told to speak English, without explaining what English actually is. But just like you learn your mother tongue, in the same way, English also comes naturally through conversation and practice. Whatever you need to learn English is available in the MySivi app, and I guide you step-by-step. When you practice this way, you see progress every day. That's why speaking fluent English in just 15 days becomes possible.] Speaker A: Te asi suneya hai ki pichle 2 saalan vich tusi 1 crore lokaan nu English sikhayi hai. Ki eh sach hai? [And we have heard that in the last 2 years you have taught English to 1 crore people. Is this true?] Speaker B: Haan ji, bilkul. Har vyakti nu usde level de hisaab naal personalized training ditti jandi hai. Misaal layi, je koi Punjabi bolda hai, taan usnu sab kuch Punjabi vich hi samjhaya janda hai. Duniya de kisi vi kone ton koi vi mere naal bina darr te jijhak de practice kar sakda hai. [Yes, absolutely. Every person is given personalized training according to their level. For example, if someone speaks Punjabi, then everything is explained to them in Punjabi itself. Anyone from any corner of the world can practice with me without fear or hesitation.] Speaker A: Te asi eh vi suneya hai ki isdi keemat aam courses ton 10 guna ghatt hai? [And we have also heard that its price is 10 times less than regular courses?] Speaker B: Haan ji. Sirf ’299 prati maheena. Naal hi tuhanu 3 dinaan da free trial vi milda hai. Je tuhanu pasand aave taan hi agge continue karo. Taan je tusi English sikhna chaunde ho, ajj hi MySivi app install karo te apna 15 dinaan da challenge shuru karo. [Yes. Only ’299 per month. Along with this, you also get a 3-day free trial. If you like it, only then continue further. So if you want to learn English, install the MySivi app today and start your 15-day challenge.]
